instruction: Open the hourly weather forecast for Manchester, GB on AccuWeather.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent navigated AccuWeather, searched for Manchester GB, selected correct result, then clicked Monthly tab to view February 2026 monthly forecast. Completed in 9 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate AccuWeather search, select location from autocomplete, switch between forecast tabs (Today/Monthly/Hourly/Daily), scroll to view full content.
metadata.task_rationale: Same city (Manchester) but different forecast type (hourly instead of monthly). Tests whether model can navigate to a different tab while keeping the same search workflow.
metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to AccuWeather, searching for Manchester GB, and opening the hourly forecast page. Evaluator checks URL contains '/manchester/' (0.5 partial credit) and 'hourly-weather' (0.5 partial credit).

llm_judge_reasons: Getter 'active_url_from_accessTree' correctly extracts the active Chrome tab URL from the accessibility tree, which is the right state to verify navigation tasks.
Metric correctly handles the expected parameter: since expected.type='rule', get_rule returns the rules dict directly, and the metric accesses expected.get('patterns', []) correctly.
URL patterns '/manchester/' and 'hourly-weather' accurately match AccuWeather's URL structure for hourly forecasts (e.g., accuweather.com/en/gb/manchester/.../hourly-weather-forecast).
Both instruction requirements are verified: correct city (Manchester via '/manchester/' pattern) and correct forecast type (hourly via 'hourly-weather' pattern).
Partial credit scoring (0.5 per pattern) is reasonable, allowing differentiation between navigating to the right city vs. the right page type.
Case-insensitive matching via .lower() adds robustness to the URL comparison.
